The Subtask Name: Create PRD for Interleaving Strings
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Product Manager
  To_agent: Product Manager
  agent_dependency_type: loop_control
  agent_strength: 0.95

  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Incorrect line number tracking or repeated insertions at the same line could cause content duplication or overwrite.
      severity: 0.8
      if_from_agent_wrong: The PRD may contain duplicate sections or missing content if line numbers are mismanaged.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The downstream Architect may receive an incomplete or malformed PRD, leading to incorrect architecture design.

The Subtask Name: Design Software Architecture
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Architect
  To_agent: Architect
  agent_dependency_type: memory_ref
  agent_strength: 0.9

  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: If the Architect misreads or misinterprets the PRD content, the system design may not align with the requirements.
      severity: 0.7
      if_from_agent_wrong: The system design may fail to meet the functional requirements specified in the PRD.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The implementation phase may encounter discrepancies between the design and the actual requirements.
